rules.qualification: The model uses generic raw-token attention and randomly initialized learned recurrence. It has no task parser, number reconstruction, arithmetic schedule, programmed carry/quotient/subtraction, data augmentation, synthetic supervision, custom loss, or participant-owned training loop.

hypothesis: A generic raw-token recurrent Transformer with an immutable prompt and tied learned workspace can discover a reusable operation without assuming decimal arithmetic or the public recurrence, making it more suitable for variable Hard tasks.
outcome: 780 updates and 399360 examples; train CE 1.648215889930725; test 11/1200 CE 3.0461775508147104; OOD 5/600 CE 3.2927026748657227; seen-N T1 3/512; OOD-N T1 0/512. Transfer and Hard-promotion gates failed.
interpretation: The large train-to-held-out CE gap is evidence of prompt-distribution fitting without a reusable transition in this exact capacity/refinement/training contract.
no_retry_history: Do not run an adjacent width, head, scratch-count, refinement-count, learning-rate, batch, or seed variant without a new mechanism for identifying the one-step operation.
